title: Second rightward scan action
statement: For a register index $r$ and states $s_0,n_x$, define an action depending on an optional Boolean. When the Boolean is present, it is the action given by the leftward register action with successor state $s_0$; when it is absent, it is the action given by the rightward register action with successor state $n_x$.
caveat: The helper action `xAct` is not defined in the supplied snippet, so its exact effects beyond the movement and successor state cannot be stated.
